description: wastnet 1.0.3 annotation MVC (wastnet-mvc: @RestController / @Endpoint / @PathParam / @WebSocket) on top of its own zero-dependency Java NIO engine. Standard configuration: a single AnnotationRouterHandler is shared by four listeners - :8080 plaintext HTTP/1.1 (carrying the WebSocket upgrade), :8081 HTTP/1.1 + TLS advertising ALPN http/1.1, :8082 h2c prior-knowledge, :8443 h2 over TLS with ALPN h2. Static files go through the framework's HttpResourceRoute (sendfile zero-copy, ETag/Last-Modified); dynamic JSON responses are compressed by the framework's built-in GZIP (HttpOptions.GZIP) and JSON is serialized per request by wast, the library wastnet's own MVC layer uses. Each listener gets a worker pool sized to the 64 available cores, and HTTP/1.1 pipelining is enabled through HttpOptions.PIPELINE_ENABLED (it is off by default). Both are documented production settings.
